user.title: Set up Foyer Home Defender
user.description: Start with one area, one zone and one scenario. Add everything else from the Foyer panel in the sidebar.

data_description.area_name: The part of the house this alarm protects, for example Home.
data_description.scenario_name: The name of the arming preset, for example Away.
data_description.zone_entity: The sensor that watches this area: a door contact, a motion sensor, a cover or a lock.

trigger.title: When is the zone triggered?
trigger.description: {entity} is currently **{current_state}**. Choose the states that mean an intrusion. Normally-closed and normally-open contacts behave in opposite ways, so check this against the real sensor: open the door or walk past it and watch its state.

data.confirm_trigger: I have checked these states against the real sensor

data_description.trigger_states: A proposal based on the entity type. Nothing is assumed: the zone fires only in the states you confirm here.
data_description.confirm_trigger: A wrong choice produces a zone that never fires, and you would find out during a break-in.

error.fault_state_as_trigger: Unavailable and unknown are faults, not triggers. They always block arming.
error.trigger_not_confirmed: Confirm that you have checked the trigger states.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Foyer Home Defender is already set up.

rejected_invalid_state.message: The area is not in a state that allows this.

rejected_ambiguous_mode.message: More than one scenario reports this mode. Choose the scenario on select.foyer_scenario.

rejected_alarm_in_progress.message: An alarm is in progress. Disarm before changing scenario.

rejected_zone_not_bypassable.message: Cannot force arming: these zones may not be bypassed: {zones}.

rejected_locked_out.message: Too many wrong codes. This channel is locked for now.

rejected_not_permitted.message: You are not allowed to do that.

rejected_user_not_valid.message: That code is not valid at the moment.

rejected_area_not_allowed.message: You are not allowed to act on that area.

rejected_scenario_not_allowed.message: You are not allowed to use that scenario.

rejected_device_not_registered.message: That device is not one of the arming devices of this installation. Add it under Arming devices before it can command the alarm.

arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm a scenario, one area, or a master mode. Returns the structured result of §9.1.

scenario_id.name: Scenario
scenario_id.description: The scenario to arm, by id.

scenario_name.name: Scenario name
scenario_name.description: The scenario to arm, by name, for an adapter that has no ids.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Arm this one area on its own, outside any scenario.

mode.name: Master mode
mode.description: Arm through the master panel: the one scenario reporting this mode. Refused when two scenarios share it.

force.name: Force
force.description: Arm anyway, excluding the zones that block it. Needs the force_arm permission and is logged as a forced arming.

skip_exit_delay.name: Skip the exit delay
skip_exit_delay.description: Arm at once, with no time to leave. Whoever may arm may arm at once, and the log records that it happened.

code.name: Code
code.description: The code of the person asking. Verified in the backend, always (INV-2).

user_id.name: User
user_id.description: Who to attribute this to in the log. It grants nothing: a claim buys that person's restrictions, never their exemptions.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: How the request arrived. Only api and automation may be claimed; keypad and nfc belong to a registered device.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The name a registered arming device answers to, from Arming devices. A name this installation does not carry is refused.

disarm.description: Disarm the named areas, or every area.

walk_test.description: Arm the house, hold every response back, and record which zones detect you. Ends by itself and never silences a 24h, tamper, technical or panic zone.
